header.running_head: Learning from Worthy and Reliable People and what Happens when Knowledge Lies with People Unworthy of it

blocks.text: Basheer bin Sa'd Abu Nu'maan (RA). Seeing me approach, they fell silent. 'O Abu Ubaydah!' I said, 'By Allaah! This is not how Rasulullaah ﷺ addressed me (he did not fall silent when I came).' He said, 'Sit down so that we may narrate a Hadith to you. Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'While you now have a Nabi in your midst, there shall soon come Khilaafah on the pattern of Nabuwaat, to be followed by monarchy and tyranny." [^1]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Makes it Clear that Seeking Knowledge from Unworthy People is Amongst the Signs of Qiyaamah

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates, "I once asked Rasulullaah ﷺ when the time will come when people will stop enjoining good and forbidding evil. Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, 'When that appears amongst you as appeared amongst the Bani Israa'eel before you.' 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ!' we submitted, 'And what was that?' Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, 'When the best amongst you start to compromise (principles), when the sinners amongst you start being shameless, when kingship falls to the lot of your youngsters and when the knowledge of Deen is carried by the wretches amongst you." [^2]

Hadhrat Abu Umayyah Jumhi (RA) reports that when they once asked Rasulullaah ﷺ about the signs of Qiyaamah, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Amongst the signs of Qiyaamah is that knowledge will be sought from juniors." [^3]
Statements of Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) Concerning Acquiring Knowledge from Seniors

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Ukaym narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) used to say, "Remember that the most truthful words are those of Allaah, the best way of life is that of Muhammad ﷺ and the worst of matters are those that have been fabricated (matters that have been made part of Deen when they are not). Take note of the fact that people will always remain in good stead as long as their knowledge comes to them from their seniors." [^4]

Hadhrat Bilaal bin Yahya reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "I know exactly when people will remain righteous and when they will start to degenerate. When the knowledge of Deen will stem from juniors, the seniors will disregard them (and degeneration will start). However, when knowledge will stem from the seniors and the juniors will follow them, both groups will be rightly guided." [^5]
